scope: Coherent wrist rotation, placement overshoot, tracking-vs-offset experiment, human bend-conditioned velocity analysis, executed preview videos

velocity: Existing speed was nonconstant. New reference clock adds smooth curvature-peak-associated speed valleys; faster traversal between bends; retains loaded/contact/rotation/tracking/acceleration limits. Energy formulation was not replaced.
